name: MH3G #31 HP-state candidate
purpose_zh: 用真实受伤和回复动作验证 0x02865D08 是 HP 变化函数：命中 0x02865FEC 时 r10 指向玩家状态，r31 为有符号变化量，+0x640/+0x642 为当前/最大 HP。只记录，不修改状态。
purpose_en: Use real damage and healing actions to prove that 0x02865D08 is the HP-change function: at 0x02865FEC, r10 points to player state, r31 is the signed delta, and +0x640/+0x642 are current/max HP. Record only; do not modify state.
operator_steps_zh: 在任务中先记录可见当前/最大 HP，然后让怪物造成一次可控伤害并运行一次 trace，记录 r31 与 +0x640/+0x642。
恢复运行后另开一次 trace，使用回复药产生真实回复；要求 r31 符号/数值方向与当前 HP 变化一致且最大 HP 不变。
本 spec 不证明 A 输入；还必须独立执行归一化输入 spec 并验证 A 为 0x2000，才能讨论按 A 每帧回复的桥接。
operator_steps_en: In a quest, note visible current/max HP, take one controlled monster hit, and run one trace while recording r31 and +0x640/+0x642.
Resume and take a separate trace while using a healing item. Require r31's sign/value direction to match the current-HP transition while maximum HP remains stable.
This spec does not prove A input. Independently run the normalized-input spec and prove A is 0x2000 before considering a per-frame press-A healing bridge.
